snippet.title: KindFolx - Official Launch Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Get a look at the Launch Trailer for KindFolx, a fast-paced deckbuilding tactical card combat game developed by Tristan Barona. Players will embody monsterfolk heroes to dispatch enemies in random encounters, build a powerful deck, and use strategic moves to end the rule of an unforgiving tyrant. KindFolx is available now for PC (Steam).
